items.title: Scalable and Adaptive Distribution Regression via Random Features

items.title: Query-Dependent Reading for Quantized Inner-Product Estimation: A Minimax Separation
items.authors: Krishnakumar Balasubramanian, Siddharth Bhandari, Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan
items.abstract: We study quantization for inner-product estimation when storage and reading have separate budgets. In the static bit-probe model [Yao, 1981], an encoder stores $w$ bits about $x$ before seeing a query $y$, and a reader probes at most $r<w$ bits to estimate $x^\top y$.
